name: Groupthink (OpenPolitics Votebot)
tagline: A collaborative democratic platform built atop GitHub, designed for open policymaking and manifesto writing
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 - Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions

news_articles.headline: OpenPolitics look to the future of democracy

policy_outcomes.description: Powered the OpenPolitics collaborative manifesto, adopted as the base platform by Something New, a UK political party that stood in multiple general elections

outcome_methodology: Anecdotal evidence from Something New party adoption; no formal evaluation framework documented
documented_limitations: setup process described as not simple
failure_modes: GitHub API rate limits or policy changes could break functionality
low adoption beyond original OpenPolitics use case
governance_model: Open source; community-contributed via GitHub PRs; voting governed by manifesto contribution rules
curation_criteria: Contributions accepted via GitHub pull requests; voting rights earned through accepted proposals; block votes available to protect core principles
contributor_governance: Contributors earn voting rights by having a proposal accepted; block votes available to protect core principles
community_ownership: Manifesto placed in public domain by OpenPolitics Project; code MIT licensed
